shots.name: m-lineup
shots.prompt:

CAMERA POSITION: the camera IS the wearer's eyes. It sits at their eye level and looks downward at roughly forty degrees toward their own lap. Because the camera is inside their head, their body cannot be seen: no chest, no torso, no shoulders, no neck, no upper arms, no t-shirt. This is not a photograph of a person and no person is visible in it.

What is visible of the wearer: only the far ends of their two forearms and their hands, entering the frame from the very bottom edge and from the bottom corners, strongly foreshortened as your own hands look when you glance down at them.

Subject: an acoustic guitar lying across the lap, seen from above and steeply foreshortened, so the near edge of its body is large at the bottom of the frame and the neck runs away toward the upper right, narrowing with distance. The left hand grips the neck partway along it, the right hand rests near the sound hole.

Floating above the guitar at a comfortable reading distance, three flat interface panels are arranged in a shallow arc, each a clean opaque rectangle with crisp edges, angled toward the viewer. Reproduce the three supplied interfaces exactly as given, one per panel, each filling its panel edge to edge: the cyan menu with the wordmark Guitar Flow and its buttons, the teal Beginner Lessons panel with its chord chart and paragraph, and the song selection screen with its list and score figures. Spell every label exactly and render all text crisp and sharp.

Set: beyond the guitar, an ordinary room floor and a wall, seen through passthrough so slightly cooler and flatter in contrast than a normal photograph, softly out of focus.

Strictly avoid: the wearer's chest or torso or shoulders in frame, a person seen from the front, a webcam or selfie framing, a headset visible in frame, bloom, glow spill, light beams, haze, particles, lens flare, duplicated or ghosted guitars, stretched or distorted objects, sci-fi styling, any text outside the panels.

Finish: photographic realism for hands, guitar and room; flat clean rendering for the panels. Very wide field of view as a headset gives, strong perspective. Immediate, first person, looking down.
